dashboard.title: Platform dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Clinics, subscriptions, users and system health at a glance.
dashboard.noTrialsEnding: No trials end in the next 14 days

clinics.title: Clinics
clinics.subtitle: Every clinic on the platform, its owner and subscription.
clinics.newHint: The owner gets an email invitation to set a password. The clinic starts with its trial.
clinics.name: Clinic name
clinics.slugHint: 3–40 lowercase letters, digits or dashes; used in the clinic's link
clinics.ownerHint: The first person registered becomes the clinic's protected owner.
clinics.planHint: Optional. The plan's trial length is used when set.
clinics.createdToast: {{name}} was created and its owner invited
clinics.emptyHint: Create the first clinic and invite its owner.
clinics.suspendBody: Everyone in the clinic keeps read-only access; nothing can be created or changed until it is activated again.
clinics.activateBody: The clinic can work normally again.
clinics.suspendedNote: This clinic is suspended: its users can only view data.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.subtitle: Plan, status and dates of every clinic's subscription.
subscriptions.editHint: Changes apply immediately. Past due, suspended and cancelled make the clinic read-only.
subscriptions.statusHint: Trial and active allow normal work.

plans.title: Plans
plans.subtitle: What clinics can subscribe to, with prices and limits.
plans.hint: Prices are in the plan's currency. Existing subscriptions are not changed by editing a plan.
plans.name: Plan name
plans.emptyHint: Create the plans clinics can subscribe to.
plans.featuresHint: Feature keys separated by commas, e.g. online_booking, jofotara

catalog.title: Global catalogs
catalog.subtitle: Shared lists every clinic starts from. Clinics copy procedures and set their own prices.
catalog.deleteBody: Clinics that already copied it keep their copy.
catalog.nameHint: Leave empty to use the built-in Arabic/English name for this code.

roleTemplates.title: Role templates
roleTemplates.subtitle: The roles every new clinic is created with.
roleTemplates.newClinicsOnly: Changes apply to clinics created from now on. Existing clinics keep their own roles.
roleTemplates.resetBody: It goes back to the built-in permissions.
roleTemplates.fullAccessLocked: The Full access template always has every permission.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Every account on the platform: clinic staff, patients and platform staff.
users.name: Name
users.disableBody: They are signed out everywhere and can't sign in until enabled again.

superadmins.title: Superadmins
superadmins.subtitle: Platform staff and what each of them can do.
superadmins.inviteHint: They get an email to set a password, then set up two-step verification.
superadmins.escalationHint: You can only grant or remove permissions you hold yourself.
superadmins.disableBody: They are signed out and lose access to the platform.

logs.title: Logs
logs.subtitle: What happened on the platform: changes, activity, user issues, errors and requests.
logs.timelineHint: Pages, changes, issues and failed requests of one user, oldest first (last 24 hours by default).
logs.timelinePick: Enter a user id to see their timeline
